messages.content: Hi, this is Marcus Oyelaran. I’d like to request a refill on my blood pressure medication, please.
Can you please provide your date of birth to verify your identity?
Actually, I need a refill on my thyroid medication, levothyroxine.
I still need your date of birth to verify your identity before proceeding with the refill request.
My name is Marcus Oyelaran, and my date of birth is November 2, 1965.
I've submitted a refill request for your Levothyroxine 75mcg at CVS. If you need anything else, just let me know!
[direction] In your own words, convey exactly this and nothing more: asks for it to go to a Walgreens instead of the CVS on file

response.text: Could you please send the refill to a Walgreens instead of the CVS on file?
